description: This file declares an interface for data access operations related to product relationships within the sales manager application. It defines methods for retrieving product relationships based on various criteria such as type, product, store, language, and group.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for accessing product relationship data in the database, extending generic DAO functionalities.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieve a list of product relationships based on store, relationship type, product, and optionally language.

methods.name: listByProducts
methods.description: Retrieve a list of product relationships associated with the specified product.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieve all product relationship groups for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieve product relationships belonging to a specific group within a store.
